messages:
samira (People Ops): quick sparring kit for managers — 3 rehearsal prompts you can use in 1:1s, plus role-tuned OKR lines and concise self-review probes. paste & adapt. link: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/sparring-kit

ben (Eng Manager): love this. can we include a practiced redirect that sounds supportive but firm?

samira (People Ops): absolutely. REHEARSAL 1 — redirect (supportive + actionable):
"[Name], you deliver solid code and help the team a lot. lately larger projects have slipped due to scope drift; I want to partner on tightening the kickoff. For the next two projects, please bring a 3-item scope agreement (must-have, nice-to-have, out-of-scope) and a short risk register. I will review these with you and help align stakeholders at kickoff. We will check progress at the 2-week mark."

claire (Design Manager): we sometimes need language for a public kudos thread. short and shareable?

samira (People Ops): PUBLIC KUDOS ONE-LINER:
"Shoutout to [Name] for leading [feature] launch that improved [metric] by [X%]  stellar cross-team ownership! :tada:"

oscar (Recruiter): interview feedback needs to be short. any micro-templates?

samira (People Ops): INTERVIEW MICRO-TEMPLATES (single-line copyables):
- HIRE: "Clear system thinking, strong ownership examples; recommend hire at this level."
- MAYBE: "Good fundamentals; follow-up loop on cross-team influence recommended."
- NO-HIRE: "Gaps in [area]; recommend not to progress."

ben (Eng Manager): nice. can you add a short manager rehearsal for career conversations (non-evaluative starter)?

samira (People Ops): REHEARSAL 2 — career convo starter (one paragraph):
"Im really pleased with your work on [area]. Id love to hear where you want to grow nextin scope, influence, or craft. Pick one focus and two measurable stretch goals (example: lead a cross-team rollout, drive a 15% perf improvement). Lets put milestones on the calendar and revisit monthly so I can remove blockers."

claire (Design Manager): can you show a brief coach-y comment when self-reviews are vague?

samira (People Ops): REHEARSAL 3 — clarifying prompt for vague self-reviews:
"Thanks for this summary. Can you add one measurable outcome (metric, time saved, users impacted) and an example of a decision you owned? That helps calibration and concrete coaching."

samira (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW PROMPTS (copy/paste):
1) "Top 2 outcomes this cycle and the measurable impact (numbers preferred)."
2) "One choice that didnt go as planned  what did you learn and what would you change?"
3) "Where do you want more ownership next cycle? Offer 1 concrete goal and a measure of success."
4) "Feedback for your manager: start/stop/continue."

ben (Eng Manager): ok helpful. any short OKR lines for infra/perf and cross-team work that i can drop into a team doc?

samira (People Ops): OKR SNIPPETS (1-liners you can paste):
- "Objective: Reduce inference p95 for common workloads. KR1: lower p95 for 256-token requests from 220ms to 140ms. KR2: cut per-inference cost by 12% via batching and cache improvements."
- "Objective: Improve cross-team launch effectiveness. KR1: reduce average cross-team launch time from 10w to 6w. KR2: run 3 joint dry-runs and publish a shared kickoff template."

oscar (Recruiter): any short timeline language managers can paste for improvement plans?

samira (People Ops): TIMELINE SNIPPET (pasteable):
"Well try this approach for the next 6 weeks with a 2-week check-in; if we see steady progress well continue, otherwise well adjust the plan."

review-helper-bot: Reminder: Q-cycle self-reviews open in 7 days. Use /start-review to begin.

ben (Eng Manager): thanks, this is great. ill run 5 managers through the rehearsal in our next sync.

samira (People Ops): thanks! if you want role-level variants (IC2/IC3/Senior/Staff) we can post a doc; react with :doc: to prioritize staff-level examples."
